 What it’s about
 Dutch Design Week is committed to the development and exchange of expertise and talent, and thereby explicitly invites different perspectives. The design profession increasingly focuses on social and other relevant issues. That is where the five missions come in: subjects that reflect what our society needs and that drive a lot of designers:
Thriving Planet
Living Environment
Digital Futures
Health & Wellbeing
Equal Society
Read more about missions →
Dutch Design Week is one of the world’s leading design events. Showcasing the work and ideas of over 2,500 designers, Dutch Design Week attracts more than 300,000 visitors from around the globe. Spread across over 120 locations in the city, the event features a diverse range of exhibitions, lectures, award ceremonies, events, debates, and festive gatherings.

 About DDW
 Dutch Design Week (DDW) is all about the design of the future and the future of design. Dutch Design Week opens up, inspires, shares and connects. During the nine-day event, Eindhoven is bursting with creativity and mind-blowing ideas. Discover how designers shape our future, covering a wide range of topics.
